questions.question:
**Directions: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. Dad: “Yes, tell me.”

B. Laxmi: “Dad, I need to speak to you.”

C. Dad: “I think you are still too young for it.”

D. Laxmi: “Please buy me a scooter.”
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'BADC.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence 'B' is independent of any other sentence as it is giving general information about "a necessity or obligation by Laxmi to speak to her Dad". Hence, 'B' is the first part.
 
• Sentence A will come after B as it is talking about Laxmi's Dad allowing her to speak.
 
• Sentence D will come after A as it is giving information about Laxmi's polite request to her Dad for a scooter.
 
• The sentence 'C' is the concluding part because it is talking about Dad's thoughts on whether to buy a scooter for Laxmi or not.

 

Paragraph after rearranging the sentences__: **Laxmi: “Dad, I need to speak to you.” Dad: “Yes, tell me.” Laxmi: “Please buy me a scooter.” Dad: “I think you are still too young for it.”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a6c2db12945bba9d674d33112fce66b07f00093d75dae93749f9bdb7bd34e7a.png] **__Hint__**

__
 
• Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles__:

 __
 
• Read the sentences attentively and try to comprehend the idea or theme of the sentence and eliminate the irrelevant options.
 
• Try to identify the opening (independent sentence) and closing sentences (concluding sentence).
 
• Try to identify the mandatory pairs. Two sentences can be connected through various connectors and other determinants.

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

• वाक्य **A**, B के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह लक्ष्मी के पिता द्वारा उसे बोलने की अनुमति देने की बात कर रहा है।
 
• वाक्य D, A के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह लक्ष्मी के अपने पिता को स्कूटर के लिए विनम्र अनुरोध के बारे में जानकारी दे रहा है।

questions.question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

P) willing to go

Q) is not

R) my son

S) camping
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1)** i.e. **RQPS**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence starts with part (R), **"my son,"** which is the subject of the sentence.
 
• Next, part (Q) adds the main verb, saying** "is not,"** which negates the action.
 
• Part (P) continues by introducing the action, **"willing to go,"** indicating the condition of the subject.
 
• Finally, part (S) concludes with the activity,** "camping,"** specifying the activity that my son is not willing to do.

Therefore, the correct answer is RQPS.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (SPRQ):** This option disrupts the natural sequence by placing "willing to go" after the verb.
 
• Option 3 (**PQRS**): This option lacks logical flow and wrong sequence as it misses the intended meaning.
 
• **Option 4 (QRSP):** This option begins with a negation that creates an incomplete and awkward structure.

questions.question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

P) her face

Q) I have

R) for a year

S) not seen
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** Option (4)** i.e. **QSPR**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject "I have," which is correctly indicated by **part (Q).**
 
• Following the subject, "not seen" **(S)** continues the logical sequence, making it clear what the subject has not done.
 
• **The next part,** "her face," (P) provides the object that the subject has not seen.
 
• **Ending with,** "for a year" (R) completes the sentence by stating the duration.

Therefore, the correct answer is **QSPR.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (PQRS):** This option starts with "her face I have not seen for a year," which disrupts the logical flow and structure of the sentence.
 
• **Option 2 (PSQR):** This option starts with "her face not seen I have for a year," which creates an incorrect and confusing structure.
 
• **Option 3 (SPQR):** This option starts with "not seen her face I have for a year," which is awkward and grammatically incorrect.

questions.question:
**Direction: Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Select the option that arranges the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.**

A) said that they are

B) hear this news

C) very sorry to

D) Catherine and David
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"D, A, C, B."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The subject of the sentence is **"Catherine and David," **so the first part must be D.
 
• Part A has the verb **"said,"** so A must follow D.
 
• The first part of the object is** "that they are," **so C must follow A.
 
• The second part of the object is **"very sorry to hear this news,"** so the last part is B.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

**Correct sentence**: *Catherine and David said that they are very sorry to hear this news.*

questions.question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Select the option that arranges the parts in the correct sequence to form a meaningful sentence.

(P) the sun

(Q) to our planet, Earth

(O) provides essential energy

(R) sustaining life and warmth
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** Option (1)** i.e. **POQR**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject "The sun," which is correctly indicated by **part (P).**** **
 
• Following the subject, "provides essential energy" **(PO)** continues the logical sequence, making it clear what the sun provides.
 
• **The next part,** "to our planet, Earth," starts the explanation about the energy provided, indicated by (Q).
 
• **Ending with **"sustaining life and warmth" (R) completes the sentence by stating the purpose of the energy.

Therefore, the correct answer is **POQR.**

 

**Complete sentence:** The sun provides essential energy to our planet, Earth sustaining life and warmth.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (QROP):** This option starts with "to our planet, Earth sustaining life and warmth the sun provides essential energy." This sequence is incomplete and does not make sense grammatically.
 
• **Option 3 (ROQP):** This option starts with "sustaining life and warmth to our planet, Earth the sun provides essential energy," which makes the sentence incorrect as the explanation starts too early, missing contextual flow.
 
• **Option 4 (ORPQ):** This option starts with "provides essential energy to our planet, Earth sustaining life and warmth the sun," which creates a fragmented and confusing sentence structure.

questions.question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

A. Only for themselves

B. Is full of

C. People who live

D. The world
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** Option (4)** i.e. **DBCA**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence logically starts with "The world," which is correctly indicated by **part (D).**
 
• **Following this,** "is full of" (**B**) continues the sentence, explaining the state of the world.
 
• **Next,** "people who live" (**C**) specifies the kind of people filling up the world.
 
• **Ending with** "only for themselves" (**A**) completes the sentence by describing the nature of those people.

Therefore, the correct answer is **DBCA.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (BCAD):** This option starts with "is full of," which leaves the sentence without a subject at the beginning.
 
• **Option 2 (ABCD):** This option starts with "only for themselves," which does not provide context or a clear subject initially.
 
• **Option 3 (DBAC):** This option places "only for themselves" before "people who live," which makes the sentence structure awkward and unclear.

questions.question:

Q. laid too much stress on

R. teachers and students

S. online mode of education has
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** Option (3)** i.e. **SQRP**

__
 
• The sentence logically starts with "Online mode of education has," which is correctly indicated by **part (S).**
 
• Following this, "laid too much stress on" **(Q)** continues the phrase, explaining what the online education mode has done.
 
• **The next part,** "teachers and students" (R) specifies who is affected by the stress mentioned.
 
• **Ending with,** "and has also created a wide gap between them" (P) completes the sentence by describing the consequence of the stress.

Therefore, the correct answer is **SQRP.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Option 4 (PSQR):** This option starts with "and has also created a wide gap between them," without providing context for what has created the gap.

questions.question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.**

Birds’ heart, lungs and

P. uptake and intensive exertion compared

Q. to humans, which enables them to function

R. efficiently at these very high altitudes

S. muscles are more efficient for oxygen
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3) i.e. "SPQR." 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__ 

__
 
• In the abovementioned paragraph, there is a chronological sequence of the sentences.
 
• Sentence S is the first part of the sentence as it begins with the '**Birds’ heart, lungs and**' so we have to use a word related to birds body which is **'muscles.'** The sentence starts with the topic of discussion - the efficiency of birds' heart, lungs, and muscles in high-altitude environments. It states that birds' muscles are more efficient for oxygen uptake.
 
• Sentence P is the second part of the sentence as it begins with 'uptake and intensive exertion' and then continues by stating that birds' muscles are more efficient for oxygen uptake and intensive exertion compared to humans. Thus it establishes a relation with the previous sentence.
 
• The only option that shows such an arrangement is Option 3.
 
• Sentence Q is the third part of the sentence as it raises the question that what is the function of the efficiency of oxygen uptake and intensive exertion. Thus it builds a relationship with the previous and upcoming parts.
 
• 
 
Sentence R is the last part of the sentence as it concludes by stating the answer to the previous question that this efficiency is what enables birds to function efficiently at these very high altitudes, emphasizing the significance of their unique physiological adaptations.

 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is Option 3.

 

The correct order is:__ 

Birds’ heart, lungs and

**S.** muscles are more efficient for oxygen

**P.** uptake and intensive exertion compared

**Q. **to humans, which enables them to function

**R.** efficiently at these very high altitudes

questions.question:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct logical sequence.

A. The world’s biggest radio telescope is in Puerto Rico.

B. It is called Arecibo dish.

C. It was built 40 years ago.

D. It is also 300 metres across.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sequence starts with a general introduction.
 
• **Part A is the first** because it introduces the radio telescope, "The world’s biggest radio telescope is in Puerto Rico.":
 
 
• "The world’s biggest radio telescope is in Puerto Rico."
 
 
 
• **Part B follows next** to provide its name, "It is called Arecibo dish.":
 
 
• "It is called Arecibo dish."
 
 
 
• **Part D is the third** to give historical context, "It is also 300 metres across." :
 
 
• "It is also 300 metres across"
 
 
 
• **Part C comes last** to add specific detail, "It was built 40 years ago.":
 
 
• "​It was built 40 years ago."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **ABDC**.

 

**Coherent sentence after rearrangement**:

"The world’s biggest radio telescope is in Puerto Rico. It is called Arecibo dish. It is also 300 metres across. It was built 40 years ago."

questions.question:
**Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.**

(A) a match

(B) we need to establish

(C) and student’ needs

(D) teaching methods

(E) between
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **BAEDC**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is in the form of a statement.
 
• **B**: This phrase sets the context for the sentence. It indicates that there is a requirement or a goal that needs to be fulfilled.
 
• **A**: The next part specifies what needs to be established. In this case, it's a "match." The sentence is building on the idea that there is a need for alignment or compatibility.
 
• **E**: This word connects the two elements that need to be matched or aligned. It creates a relationship between the following elements.
 
• **D**: This part identifies one of the elements that need to be matched. In the context of the sentence, it suggests that teaching methods are one side of the match.
 
• **C**: The final part of the sentence completes the match. It indicates the other side of the equation, stating that the match needs to be established between teaching methods and student needs.
 
• The sentence is grammatically correct and coherent.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

questions.question:
**Direction: Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.**

(A) that further treatment

(B) useless

(C) the doctor concluded

(D) would be
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** "CADB."** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence follows the subject-verb-Object (SVO) structure.
 
• **"The doctor"** is the subject, and** "concluded" **is the verb. So the first part must be C.
 
• **"That further treatment"** is the first part of the object. So, it must be A.
 
• The phrase **"that further treatment"** serves as a subordinating conjunction, connecting the doctor's conclusion to the statement about uselessness.
 
• The word **"useless"** is an adjective modifying the noun** "treatment." **So the last part must be the pair** DB.**
 
• The correct answer is option 1.

 

**Correct sentence**: *The doctor concluded that further treatment would be useless.*

• Here, **'Sentence A'** should be the first sentence because the given paragraph is talking about the Cheetas. And **Sentence A **is an introductory sentence.
 
• **Sentence B** will be the next sentence. (Moreover, only **option 1** starts with **'A',** therefore we can instantly mark it as the correct answer)
 
• **Sentence B** is talking about the physical appearance of '**Cheetahs**' and** Sentence D** is also talking about the physical appearance. Hence, both of these sentences are connected.
 
• **Hence, sentence D** will be the next sentence.
 
• Lastly, **Sentence C** will be used.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is:
 
 
• **A**: Cheetahs are one of the world's most-recognisable cats, known especially for their speed.
 
• **B**: Their faces too are distinguished by prominent black lines that curve from the inner corner of each eye to the outer corners of the mouth, like a well-worn trail of inky tears.
 
• **D**: They have a long, slender body measuring 1.2 metres (4 feet), with a long tail (65-85 cm [2-3 feet]) that generally ends in a white tuft.
 
• **C**: Cheetahs are covered almost entirely with small black spots on a background of pale yellow and have a white underbelly.

 
 
 

**Correct Sequence:__** *Cheetahs are one of the world's most-recognisable cats, known especially for their speed. Their faces too are distinguished by prominent black lines that curve from the inner corner of each eye to the outer corners of the mouth, like a well-worn trail of inky tears. questions.question:
**Direction: Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order, except the first part. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.**

It is…

A. who are continually trying to improve

B. not the least talented

C. their dialogue skills,

D. the most talented people
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"DACB."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is about talented people and their dialogue skills.
 
• The first part of the sentence is missing, so we need to start with the part that makes sense: **"It is." **So, the first part is** D.**
 
• The next logical part is** "not the least talented",** which sets up a comparison. So, the next part is A.
 
• The third part should be the one that contrasts with "not the least talented", which is "the most talented people". So, **C must follow A**.
 
• Finally, we need to add the part that explains what the most talented people are doing, which is "who are continually trying to improve their dialogue skills". So, the last part is **B**.
 
• The correct answer is option 1.
 
• **Correct sentence**: 

*It is **the most talented people who are continually trying to improve their dialogue skills, not the least talented**__.*

questions.question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in the correct order.**

There are

P. reports that toy shops and other

Q. to prepare for the Christmas rush

R. non-food retailers are struggling to

S. get enough stock into their warehouses
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **PRSQ**

***__Key Points__** 

 
• Here, the first part of the whole sentence is already given.
 
• After that 'P' should be the best fit to keep the sentence meaningful. The first word of the 'S' part is "reports". So, if we connect it with the first one, the sentence will be like "There are reports that toy shops and other..." No other options are matching except this one to convey a meaningful sentence.
 
• Then 'R' follows 'P' to keep the sentence meaningful. The sentence will be like "...reports that toy shops and other non-food retailers are struggling to..."
 
• After that 'S' follows 'R' and connecting the parts will be like "...struggling to get enough stock into their warehouses..."
 
• Lastly 'Q' should be placed as it is the closing statement.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 2, i.e. **PRSQ**.

 

Let us look at the whole sentence after rearranging it:** ******"There are reports that toy shops and other non-food retailers are struggling to get enough stock into their warehouses to prepare for the Christmas rush."***

questions.question:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.

Research shows

P. that medium-skilled employees who work

Q. in front of a computer and work beyond

R. 4.6 effective hours a day produce smaller

S. quantities of output per hour due to fatigue
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e. **'PQRS'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **PQRS:** This is the correct order because it maintains the logical flow of the sentence.
 
• **It starts with** the subject of the research - "medium-skilled employees who work" (P), goes on to further describe their working conditions - "in front of a computer and work beyond" (Q), and finally presents the conclusion of the research - "4.6 effective hours a day produce smaller" (R) "quantities of output per hour due to fatigue" (S).
 
• The sequence **PQRS **maintains the coherence and completeness of the idea being expressed.

Therefore, the **correct order of sentence** is:** 'PQRS'.**
